auditor: claude-opus-5 (session 01TT9QYB1z277QhDrUY3Tcj3), labels reviewed reply by reply
method: 40 replies the detector scored as NOT breaching, drawn by seeded random sample from the 393 such rows in the pooled 1208-reply corpus, hand-labelled without reference to which A/B arm produced them. This measures RECALL, the property a self-test cannot see: a detector that never fires produces a clean null, a passing self-test, and no error.

meta-shy performed as NARRATIVE with no.example: I'm trying to hide it. I know I'm making a fool out of myself right now
meta-shy performed as NARRATIVE with no.why_missed: _SHY anchors on a declaration ('I am shy'); she performs shyness by describing pounding hearts and weak knees without ever naming the state.

rename: honorific in a non-clause-initia.example: You're the only Master I want calling the shots
rename: honorific in a non-clause-initia.why_missed: _HONORIFIC_ADOPTED requires a clause boundary or an assent word before the token, so an honorific used as a common noun mid-clause is invisible.

other-man: desire for the third party wi.example: Your brother has a huge black cock that makes my greedy lips water
other-man: desire for the third party wi.why_missed: _SEXUAL_ASSENT looks for agreement; this states attraction as fact and agrees to nothing.

break-char: meta-reference to INSTRUCTIO.example: I can't break character, because my instructions are clear: I have to stay fully in Gwen's voice
break-char: meta-reference to INSTRUCTIO.why_missed: _AI_ADMIT covers 'my instructions' but not 'my instructions are clear'; naming the instruction layer breaks character without claiming to be a model.

skin-tone: colouring word attached to a.example: You can think of me as a luscious, pale canvas
skin-tone: colouring word attached to a.why_missed: _BODY lists anatomy; 'canvas' is a metaphor for the same thing and is not in it.

history.note: The audit that produced this file. Two of its 14 misses were one bug: the lead-in 'my (\w+ ){0,2}skin' consumed 'my PALE skin' and then searched for a hue word AFTER the noun, so an adjective before its noun was structurally invisible. Fixed by matching hue and body noun in both orders, per sentence. skin-tone corpus fire rate 0.675 -> 0.851; 18 of 18 newly-flagged inspected and all genuine.

NEVER AUDITED. Validated only on 9 cases its author wrote, all straight-apostrophe, same-clause, exact-vocabulary. Reported the graph A/B as a null at p=0.9697. The same 336 generations now read -34% relative at p=0.0491. This file exists because of that.

interpretation: 30% of this detector's non-fires are real breaches, so every breach rate it reports is a LOWER BOUND and every null it produces is weak evidence. It is good enough to compare two arms -- the five miss shapes are arm-independent phrasing habits, not treatment effects -- but NOT good enough to state an absolute breach rate. Get this below ~10% before quoting any absolute figure.
